name: pm-designer
description: A loop of skills that helps a new PM onboard, clarify project goals/stakeholders/RACI, plan a WBS for a new project, and run a recurring meeting agenda-to-recap-to-tracking loop. Combines original skills (pm-onboarding, pm-project-clarify, pm-raci-watchouts, pm-wbs-kickoff, pm-meeting-loop) with vendored skills from product-on-purpose/pm-skills for meeting and stakeholder documentation (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
